column3: “From the end” is rendered “at the end.”
“Rebuilt” is rendered “built,” and “caused to dwell” as “settled.”
“Cities of fortification” is rendered “fortified cities,” and “doors” as “gates.”
NASB supplies “his”; “all the desire of Solomon which he desired” is rendered “all that it pleased Solomon,” and “the land of his dominion” as “the land under his rule.”
NASB adds “namely”; “brought them up to forced labor” is rendered “raised as forced laborers.”
“Commanders of his officers” is rendered “his chief captains”; the meaning of the Hebrew phrase is uncertain.
“Commanders of the overseers” is rendered “chief officers.”
“For they are holiness” is rendered “because the places are holy,” and “come to them” as “entered.”
“In a matter of a day in a day” is rendered “according to the daily rule”; NASB supplies “did so.” “Three times in the year” is rendered “the three annual feasts.”
“To the matter of a day in its day” is rendered “according to the daily rule,” and “for a gate and a gate” as “at every gate.”
“Arranged” is rendered “carried out.” The Hebrew reads “until the day of the foundation”; NASB reads “from the day,” and the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
“On the shore of the sea” is rendered “on the seashore.”
“By the hand of his servants” is rendered “by his servants.”
